description: Structured screening criteria (ADR-0012) and their hand-written labels, for measuring services/cv_facts and services/structured_match -- the engine that answers the product's default path. The existing jobs.json and labels.json measure the older profile-and-model path, which is now the exception. Every verdict here was read from the candidate's own CV text in candidates.json and from the criterion's stated meaning; none was copied from the engine's output, because a label taken from the thing under test measures nothing.
